arguments.question: Across ANET, MU, META and NVDA, use the seeded SEC facts/submissions (and NVDA primary feed if material) to identify the most recent reported revenue, profitability/cash-flow trajectory, balance-sheet capacity, and company-specific demand/supply or regulatory risks that could affect 21/63-session scenarios. For QQQ, inspect the dated sponsor profile/holdings only for look-through concentration and overlap with the named companies. Clearly separate sourced facts from inferences; do not provide a preferred investment conclusion. Stop once the latest filed/dated data establish material drivers and explicitly state any unavailable forward or earnings-date evidence.
arguments.decision_impact: Supplies factual operating and ETF-look-through inputs for differentiated short-horizon theses and identifies where company valuation or event risk is unsupported.
